pred_texts: Instruct: Take a large pan and add four tablespoons of olive oil.

Feedback: You are using a measuring spoon to add the oil, but the instruction specifies adding four tablespoons. A standard measuring spoon is typically a teaspoon or a tablespoon, but it is not a standard kitchen tool for measuring four tablespoons of oil at once. You should use a liquid measuring cup or a larger measuring spoon to ensure you are adding the correct amount of oil.
Instruct: Switch on the stove with the pan, at high heat.
Feedback: You are turning the stove knob to the lowest setting (indicated by the single dot) instead of high heat as required by the instruction.
Instruct: Meanwhile, get the tofu, around 350 grams, and cut it into small even cubes.
Feedback: You are cutting the tofu into large rectangular blocks instead of small even cubes as instructed.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Let the oil heat until it's shimmering first. You can test it with one tofu cube. It should sizzle gently when you add it to the pan.

Feedback: You are currently cutting the tofu into cubes, but the instruction requires you to let the oil heat until it is shimmering first. You should stop cutting and test the oil temperature by adding a single tofu cube to the pan to ensure it sizzles gently before proceeding with the rest of the tofu.

Feedback: You have tested the oil temperature with a single tofu cube, but you have not waited for it to sizzle gently or removed it before proceeding. You should wait for the gentle sizzle to confirm the oil is ready, then remove the test cube before adding the rest of the tofu to the pan.

Feedback: You have added a single tofu cube to the pan to test the oil, but you have not waited for it to sizzle gently or removed it before proceeding. You should wait for the gentle sizzle to confirm the oil is ready, then remove the test cube before adding the rest of the tofu to the pan.

Feedback: You have added a single tofu cube to the pan to test the oil, but you have not waited for it to sizzle gently or removed it before proceeding. You should wait for the gentle sizzle to confirm the oil is ready, then remove the test cube before adding the rest of the tofu to the pan.
Instruct: Add the tofu gently to the pan. Let is cook for about 2 minutes, gently stirring to prevent burning. Then turn the heat to medium and cover the pan with a lid.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Grab a green bell pepper, wash it and chop the bell pepper into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Check on the tofu and stir it once more. Make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom.

Feedback: You are stirring the tofu with a wooden spoon, but you are not checking if it is sticking to the bottom of the pan as instructed. You should lift the spoon to inspect the bottom of the pan to ensure the tofu isn't burning or sticking.
Instruct: Now, grab two small shallots and cut it also into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Add the cut shallot and the cut bell pepper to the pan.
Instruct: Push the tofu to one side and then push the chopped vegetables into open space.
Feedback: You are stirring the ingredients together instead of pushing the tofu to one side to create space for the vegetables.
Instruct: Let it cook uncovered until the bell pepper is soft. Stir occasionally. Cook for about three minutes.
Feedback: You covered the pan with a lid, but the instruction explicitly states to cook it uncovered. This will trap steam and prevent the bell peppers from softening properly.
Instruct: Now add five teaspoons of soy sauce to the tofu and veggies in the pan. Spread the soya sauce evenly through out the pan.
Feedback: You are using a tablespoon to measure the soy sauce instead of a teaspoon, which will result in adding too much soy sauce to the pan.
Instruct: Stir to mix the soya sauce together with the tofu and veggies.

Feedback: You are holding the soy sauce bottle upside down, which will cause the liquid to spill out uncontrollably instead of pouring it into the pan. You need to turn the bottle upright to pour the sauce correctly.

Feedback: You are holding the wooden spoon upside down, which will cause the liquid to spill out uncontrollably instead of pouring it into the pan. You need to turn the spoon upright to pour the sauce correctly.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of ketchup and salt if required after tasting.
Feedback: You are currently stirring the vegetables in the pan, but the instruction requires you to add ketchup and salt. You need to stop stirring and proceed with adding the seasonings.
Feedback: You are adding salt to the vegetables, but the instruction requires you to add ketchup first. You need to add the ketchup before seasoning with salt.
Instruct: Mix everything well and let it cook for another three and half minutes.
Instruct: Turn off the heat and cover the pan with a lid.

Feedback: You are turning off the heat with your left hand while simultaneously stirring the vegetables with your right hand. This action directly interferes with the instruction to "cover the pan with a lid" because you are not holding the lid or the handle of the pan, making it difficult to place the lid on securely and safely.
Success: Step complete.
